harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عجبًا». «أن» is a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أن» and what follows it is the noun of kāna, and «عجبًا» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. «أن أنذر»: «أن» is explicative, and the clause «أنذر» is explicative. The interpreted maṣdar «أن لهم قدم صدق» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The clause «قال الكافرون» is resumptive. [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this part of the source are misplaced; the words quoted are rendered here according to the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «يُدَبِّرُ الأمر» is a second khabar (predicate), in the position of the nominative, and the clause «ما من شفيع» is a third khabar. «مِنْ» in «من شفيع» is redundant (zāʾida), and «شفيع» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it is preceded by a negation. «إلا» is for restriction, and the preposition «من بعد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. «ذلكم الله»: mubtadaʾ and khabar; «ربكم» is a badal (substitute) in the nominative. The clause «فاعبدوه» is conjoined to the clause «ذلكم الله», and the clause «أفلا تذكَّرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The preposition «إليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «مرجعكم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). «وجميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf; a ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi is permissible because the muḍāf is a maṣdar (verbal noun). «وَعْدَ» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and likewise «حقًا». The preposition «بالقسط» is attached to «يجزي». The clause «والذين كفروا ...» is resumptive; the relative noun is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «لهم شراب» is the khabar. «ما» in «بما كانوا» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar is attached to the "being" (istiqrār) to which «لهم» is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «والقمر»: conjoined to «الشمس», and «نورًا» is conjoined to «ضياء». The clause «وقدَّره» is conjoined to the clause «جعل», and «منازل» is an adverb of place. «والحساب»: conjoined to «عدد». The clause «ما خلق الله» is resumptive, and the preposition «إلا بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent). The clause «يفصل» is a ḥāl from the word of majesty (Allah), and the clause «يعلمون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «ما خلق»: a relative noun conjoined to «اختلاف», and the preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». «لآيات»: the lām is for emphasis, and the noun of «إنَّ». The preposition «لِقَوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «هم عن آياتنا غافلون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, and the preposition «عن آياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «غافلون».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «أولئك مأواهم النار»: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «مأواهم» is a second mubtadaʾ, and «النار» is the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «إن» in the preceding verse, and the clause «مأواهم النار» is the khabar of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «يهديهم ربهم» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause «تجري من تحتهم الأنهار» is a second khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «دعواهم فيها»: a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with a ḍamma implied because of impossibility; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the mubtadaʾ. «سبحانك»: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "we glorify". «اللهم»: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the mīm is redundant (zāʾida), as a compensation for «يا». The clause «دعواهم فيها سبحانك» is a third khabar (predicate) of the preceding «إن», and the clause "we glorify, glory be to You" is the khabar of «دعواهم». The clause «اللهم» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items. The clause «وتحيتهم فيها سلام» is conjoined to the clause «دعواهم فيها سبحانك», and the preposition «فيها» is attached to a ḥāl from «تحيتهم». The clause «وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد» is conjoined to the clause «تحيتهم سلام». «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «الحمد لله» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the lightened «أنْ». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الحمد لله» is the khabar of «آخر دعواهم». No separating word was placed between the lightened «أنْ» and its khabar because the khabar is a nominal clause.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «استعجالهم» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the preposition «بالخير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (استعجالهم). The clause «فنذر» is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "but We give them respite, so We leave…". The preposition «في طغيانهم» is attached to «يعمهون», and the clause «يعمهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يرجون».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition «لجنبه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «دعا», and «أو قاعدًا» is conjoined to the preceding implied ḥāl. The clause «فلما كشفنا» is conjoined to the clause «دعانا», with no grammatical position. The clause «كأن لم يدعنا» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «مرَّ»; «كأنْ» is lightened from the heavy form, its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause «لم يدعنا» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأنْ». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "it was made attractive to the transgressors with an adornment like that adornment". «ما» in «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «زُيِّن» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «ولقد أهلكنا القرون» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد أهلكنا» is the answer to the oath. The clause «لما ظلموا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «من قبلكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرون». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We recompense the people with a recompense like that recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «خلائف». The clause «كيف تعملون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the "seeing", which has the meaning of knowing. «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «غير» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قرآن», and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أبدله» is the noun of «يكون», and the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «يكون». «إن أتبع»: «إن» is negating, and the clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The clause «إن عصيت» is parenthetical, and the clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فقد لبثت» is conjoined to the clause «أدراكم», with no grammatical position, and the clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «فمن أظلم» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أظلم» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن افترى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «عند الله»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شفعاء». «سبحانه» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is omitted, i.e. "we glorify", and the clause «سبحانه» is resumptive. The preposition «عمَّا» is attached to the implied "we glorify".

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «وما كان الناس إلا أمة» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items: «يقولون» in verse (20) and «يقولون» in verse (18). The clause «ولولا كلمة» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان». «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and «كلمة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing". The clause «سبقت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كلمة».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the preposition «من ربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية». The clause «فقل» is resumptive, and the clause «فانتظروا» is resumptive, as is the emphatic clause. The adverb «معكم» is attached to «المنتظرين», and the preposition «من المنتظرين» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; the implied form is: "they displayed scheming when We made them taste". «إذا» [Translator's note: the second one] is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «إذا لهم مكر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. «مكرًا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the preposition «في آياتنا» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) (مكر).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). The two prepositional phrases «بهم» and «بريح» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جرين»; it is permissible for two identical particles to be attached to one governing word because the first bāʾ is for transitivity and the second for cause. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم أحيط» stands in place of the two objects of «ظن». «مخلصين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «دعوا», and the preposition «له» is attached to «مخلصين». The lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa). The clause «دعوا» is a badal (substitute) from «ظنوا», a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl), with no grammatical position, because of the connection between them: their supplication is one of the consequences of their thinking they would perish. The clause «لئن أنجيتنا» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, and the implied saying is a ḥāl, i.e. "they called, saying". The clause «لنكونن» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «هم يبغون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. «متاع»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "you enjoy". The clause "you enjoy an enjoyment" is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the second-person pronoun, in the position of the accusative. The clause «ثم إلينا مرجعهم» is conjoined to the implied clause "you enjoy", in the position of the accusative, and the clause «فَنُنَبِّئُكُمْ» is conjoined to the clause «إلينا مرجعهم».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive. The two objects of «جعل» are the hāʾ and «حصيدًا». «كأن» is a lightened abrogating particle, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The clause «كأن لم تغن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «جعلناها». The clause «نفصِّل» is resumptive. The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form is: "We detail the signs with a detailing like that detailing". The clause «يتفكرون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «وزيادة»: a noun conjoined to «الحسنى». The clause «ولا يرهق» is conjoined to «الحسنى», of the type of conjoining a clause to a single word. The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «والذين كسبوا ...» is conjoined to the clause «للذين أحسنوا الحسنى», with no grammatical position. The clause «جزاء سيئة بمثلها» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين», and the preposition «بمثلها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «جزاء». The clause «وترهقهم ذلة» is conjoined to the clause «جزاء سيئة بمثلها», of the type of conjoining a verbal clause to a nominal one. «من عاصم»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «لهم» is attached to the khabar, and the preposition «من الله» is attached to «عاصم». The clause «ما لهم من الله من عاصم» is a second khabar, and the clause «كأنما أغشيت» is a third khabar. «قطعًا»: the second object, and «مظلمًا» is a second naʿt (adjective), because «من الليل» is a naʿt. The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The wāw is resumptive. «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» ("remember"). «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «نحشرهم». «مكانكم»: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "stay firm", transferred from the adverb; its fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "you", and the mentioned «أنتم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the verbal noun. «شركاؤكم» is a noun conjoined to the latent pronoun in the verbal noun. The clause «فزيلنا» is resumptive. «إيانا»: a detached accusative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi placed before the verb «تعبدون».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «بالله»: the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). «شهيدًا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the adverb «بيننا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيدًا». «إن كنا»: «إنْ» is lightened, and the lām in «لغافلين» is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) between the lightened and the inoperative [Translator's note: i.e. the negating «إن»], since the inoperative one is not followed by it. The clause «إن كنا لغافلين» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «هنا»: a demonstrative, an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تبلو». «مولاهم الحق»: a badal (substitute) and its naʿt (adjective). «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «ضل».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «مَنْ يرزقكم»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning "rather" plus the interrogative hamza; «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. «فسيقولون الله»: the word of majesty is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the doer is Allah". The clause «أفلا تتقون» is conjoined to an implied clause which is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. "do you persist, and so not fear Him?".

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is for address. «الله» is the khabar (predicate), «ربكم» is a badal (substitute), and «الحق» is its naʿt (adjective). «فماذا بعد الحق إلا الضلال»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; «ذا» is a relative noun, khabar; «بعد» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); «إلا» is for restriction; «الضلال» is a badal from the interrogative noun «ما». «فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «أَنَّى» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial), meaning "how"; and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct); the implied form is: "the word was confirmed with a confirming like that". The clause «حقَّت» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم لا يؤمنون» is a badal (substitute) from «كلمة».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The preposition «من شركائكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «من». The clause «قل» is resumptive. «فأنى تؤفكون»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «أنى» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «فأنى تؤفكون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «أفمن يهدي»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «أحق أن يتبع»: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. «أمن لا يهدي»: «أم» is a conjunction, and «من» is a relative conjoined to the preceding «من»; «أم» and what it is conjoined to are separated by the khabar, as in: أزيد قائم أم عمرو؟ ("Is Zayd standing, or ʿAmr?"). «إلا أن يهدى»: «إلا» is for exception, and the maṣdar is excepted from the most general of states, i.e. "the one who does not guide in any state except the state of being guided". «فما لكم كيف تحكمون»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «تحكمون» is a ḥāl from the second-person pronoun in «لكم».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «ظنًا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "except the following of conjecture". «شيئًا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "it does not avail, with any availing, little or much".

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفترى» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, i.e. "something of fabrication"; the maṣdar itself was used, for intensification. «ولكن تصديق»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لكن» is a particle of qualification (istidrāk), and «تصديق» is the khabar of a concealed kāna; the clause "but it was a confirmation" is conjoined to the clause «ما كان هذا القرآن». The clause «لا رَيْبَ فيه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكتاب», and the preposition «من رب العالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «الكتاب».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «أم يقولون»: «أَمْ» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive. The clause «فأتوا» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring". The preposition «من دون الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». The clause "if you are truthful, then bring" is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «بل كذَّبوا» is resumptive. The clause «ولما يأتهم تأويله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يحيطوا». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form is: "they denied with a denial like that denial". The clause «فانظر» is conjoined to the resumptive «كذب», with no grammatical position. «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and «عاقبة» is the noun of kāna. The clause «كيف كان» is the object of the "looking", suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which includes the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «وربك أعلم بالمفسدين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «أنتم بريئون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The meaning of «مَنْ» was observed, so it is plural in «من يستمعون»: the pronoun was referred back to it in the plural. More common is observing its wording, as in the following verse: «مَنْ ينظر». The clause «ولو كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «أفأنت تسمع», with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the clause is not circumstantial.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ولو كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «أفأنت تهدي».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «شيئًا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), in the sense of "He does not wrong with any wrong, little or much". The clause «ولكن الناس يظلمون» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله لا يظلم».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The wāw is resumptive. «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember". «كأن» is lightened, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «إلا» is for restriction; «ساعة» is an adverb of time. The clause «كأن لم يلبثوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «يحشرهم», and the clause «يتعارفون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يلبثوا». The clause «قد خسر الذين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «وإمَّا نرينك»: the wāw is resumptive, «إنْ» is conditional, and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the verb is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the jussive, because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis. The clause «فإلينا مرجعهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «ثم الله شهيد» is conjoined to the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause «لكل أمة رسول». The clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «بينهم».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «متى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الوعد» is a badal (substitute). The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «إلا ما شاء»: «إلا» is a particle of exception, and «ما» is a relative, the excepted, i.e. "except what He wills that I should possess and be able to do, by His permission". The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «فهم لا يستأخرون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «يستأخرون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «بياتاً» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتاكم». The first object of «أرأيتم» is omitted, i.e. "your situation". The expression belongs to the category of contention (tanāzuʿ) between two verbs, «رأيتم» and «أتاكم»; the second was made operative, so it put «عذابه» in the nominative as fāʿil (agent). The meaning is: "Say to them: tell me about the punishment of Allah, if it comes to you". The clause «إن أتاكم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then tell me". «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate), and the clause «ماذا يستعجل منه المجرمون» is the second object of «أرأيتم».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «أثم إذا ما وقع» is conjoined to the clause «أرأيتم». «آلآن»: the hamza is for interrogation, and an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «آمنتم», i.e. "do you believe now?"; the overt one does not govern it, because what precedes the interrogative does not govern what follows it. The wāw is circumstantial.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun). The clause «ثم قيل» is conjoined to the implied «آمنتم» in the preceding verse, and the clause «هل تجزون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «أحق هو» is the second object of the verb «يستنبئونك»; «حق» is a khabar (predicate) placed first, and the pronoun «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. «إي» is a particle of answer, and the wāw is for the oath. «ربي» is a noun genitive by the wāw, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "I swear", and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «وما أنتم بمعجزين» is conjoined to the answer to the oath; «ما» operates like laysa, and the bāʾ in its khabar is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أنَّ» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» ("it were established"). The clause «ظلمت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نفس». The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قضي» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar, i.e. "the judgement was judged", and the preposition «بالقسط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قضي». The clause «لما رأوا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «بينهم».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «ما» is a relative noun, the noun of «إن». The clause «ولكنَّ أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «إن وعد الله حق», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «وإليه ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «هو يحيي», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The answer to the vocative is a resumptive clause. The preposition «في الصدور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause) "is found" (استقر).

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The preposition «بفضل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb indicated by what follows it, i.e. "let them rejoice". The fāʾ in «فبذلك» is redundant (zāʾida), and «بذلك» is a badal (substitute) from the first prepositional phrase. The fāʾ in «فليفرحوا» connects the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the bounty has come to them", and the lām is the jussive lām of command. The clause "if the bounty has come to them" is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and likewise the clause «هو خير».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «أرأيتم» means "tell me". The preposition «من رزق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted referent pronoun, i.e. "what Allah has sent down, being of provision". The second clause «قل» is resumptive, an emphasis of the preceding «قل». The clause «آلله أذن» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl). The second object of «أرأيتم» is omitted, indicated by the context, i.e. "who permitted you this?". The referent pronoun from this clause to the first object is omitted, i.e. "regarding it". The clause «تفترون» is conjoined to the clause «أذن».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ظنُّ» is its khabar (predicate). «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ظن». The clause «ولكن أكثرهم لا يشكرون» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله لذو فضل».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «ما» is negating. «من قرآن» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with «مِن» redundant (zāʾida), and likewise «عَمَل» is a mafʿūl bihi. «إلا» is for restriction, and the clause «كنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تعملون»; the past verb follows «إلا» without «قد» because it is preceded by a verb. «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهودا». «مثقال» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant. «أصغر»: a noun conjoined to «مثقال», genitive like it, with fatḥa, because it is a diptote. The clause «وما يعزب» is conjoined to the clause «لا تعملون». «إلا في كتاب»: «إلا» is a particle of disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), and the preposition is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is in a Book"; the clause is resumptive, with the meaning: "but all things are in a Book".

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». «لا» is negating and operates like laysa, and «خوف» is its noun.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «لهم البشرى» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين» in the preceding verse. The preposition «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البشرى». The clause «لا تبديل لكلمات الله» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ذلك هو الفوز»; the pronoun «هو» is for separation (faṣl), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clauses of the verse are resumptive. «جميعًا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العزة».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «مَنْ» is the noun of «إن», and the preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). «وما يتبع»: the wāw is resumptive, and «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يتبع». The preposition «من دون الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شركاء», and «شركاء» is the object of «يدعون». «إنْ» is negating, and the clause «وإن هم إلا يخرصون» is conjoined to the resumptive one; the clause «يخرصون» is the khabar (predicate) of «هم».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The second object of «جعل» is omitted, i.e. "dark". The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لأن تسكنوا» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل». «والنهار مبصرًا»: «النهار» is conjoined to «الليل», and «مبصرًا» is conjoined to the implied "dark"; thus the wāw has conjoined two governed words to two governed words, with a single governing word for them. The implied form of the speech is: "He it is who made for you the night dark that you may rest in it, and the day giving sight that you may move about in it"; "dark" was omitted because «مبصرًا» indicates it, and "that you may move about" was omitted because «لتسكنوا» indicates it.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «سبحانه» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "we glorify, glory be to Him", and the clause is resumptive. The clause «هو الغني» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «سبحانه», and the clause «له ما في السماوات» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «الغني». The clause «إن عندكم من سلطان» is resumptive; «إن» is negating, «سلطان» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «أتقولون» is resumptive. «ما» is a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «لا يفلحون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «متاع» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "that is an enjoyment". The preposition «في الدنيا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «متاع». The clause «ثم إلينا مرجعهم» is conjoined to the clause "that is an enjoyment", and the clause «ثم نذيقهم» is conjoined to the clause «إلينا مرجعهم». «ما» in «بما كانوا» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to «نذيقهم».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «نبأ». «إن كان كبر»: the noun of kāna is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause «كبر مقامي» is in the position of the accusative as its khabar (predicate). The clause «فعلى الله توكلت» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); a semi-clause (prepositional phrase) has been placed before the verb of the apodosis, which is what made the fāʾ necessary. «وشركاءكم»: a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); it was not conjoined to «أمركم» because one does not say أجمع زيد الشركاء; rather one says جمع. أجمع relates to abstract things, not to persons: you say أجمعت أمري ("I resolved my affair"), and you do not say أجمعت شركائي. The clause «فأجمعوا» is conjoined to the apodosis, in the position of the jussive. «ولا تنظرون»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «إن أجري»: «إن» is negating, «أجري» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «على الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أكون» is accusative by removal of the preposition. The clause «وأمرت أن أكون» is conjoined to the clause «إن أجري إلا على الله», which is resumptive within the scope of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «ومَن معه»: a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «نجيناه»; «معه» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition «في الفلك» is attached to the implied ṣila. The pronoun in «جعلناهم» is plural, in accordance with the meaning of «من». «كيف» in «كيف كان عاقبة» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the "looking", suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which includes the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «ليؤمنوا»: the lām is for denial (juḥūd), and the verb is accusative by a concealed «أن» after the lām; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of kāna, i.e. "intending belief". «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We seal them with a sealing like that sealing". The clause «نطبع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The two prepositional phrases «إلى فرعون» and «بآياتنا» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بعثنا».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «فلما جاءهم» is conjoined to the clause «كانوا», and the clause «قالوا» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «لما جاءكم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «أسحر»: a khabar (predicate) placed first, and «هذا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. The clause «ولا يفلح الساحرون» is conjoined to the clause «أتقولون».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكبرياء». «ما» operates like laysa, and the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «وما نحن لكما بمؤمنين» is conjoined to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The clause «أنتم ملقون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «فلما ألقوا» is conjoined to the clause «فلما جاء السحرة», with no grammatical position. «ما» in «ما جئتم» is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «السحر» is its khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «ولو كره المجرمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the aforementioned establishing (الإحقاق). This wāw is circumstantial; it conjoins to an implied element, i.e. "Allah establishes the truth in every state, even in this state", and this is for exhausting all states.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: «ذرية» is the fāʿil (agent) of «آمن», and the preposition «على خوف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the qualified «ذرية». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفتنهم» is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «فرعون».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «إن كنتم مسلمين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «ربنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «فتنة» is the second object of the "making", and the preposition «للقوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «أن تبوَّآ»: «أن» is explicative, and the clause is explicative of the revelation. «اجعلوا» is made transitive to two objects.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The second clause «ربنا» is parenthetical, and the third clause «ربنا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «ليضلوا»: accusative by a concealed «أن» after the lām of cause, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آتيت». «فلا يؤمنوا»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), «لا» is negating, and the verb is accusative by a concealed «أن» after the fāʾ; the maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be from You a hardening of their hearts, and so a lack of belief on their part".

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «ولا تتبعانِّ»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position. The clause «فاستقيما» is conjoined to the clause «أجيبت», in the position of the accusative. The verb «تتبعانِّ» is jussive by dropping of the nūn, the alif is the fāʿil, and the nūn is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: «بغيًا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive. «لا إله إلا الذي»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «إله» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī); «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «الذي» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate), whose implied form is "deserving of worship"; and the clause is the khabar of «أن». The clause «وأنا من المسلمين» is conjoined to the clause «آمنتُ».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «آلآن»: the hamza is for interrogation, and «الآن» is an adverb of time indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "you believe". The clause «وقد عصيت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in the implied "you believe". The clause "you believe" is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, "He said", and the clause "He said" is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The fāʾ is a conjunction. «اليوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ننجيك», and the clause «ننجيك» is conjoined to the clause «كنت». The preposition «لمن خلفك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آية», and the adverb «خلفك» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition «عن آياتنا» is attached to «غافلون», the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «مبوَّأ» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «فما اختلفوا» is conjoined to the clause «رزقناهم». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن جاءهم» is genitive by «حتى», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اختلفوا».

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The preposition «مما أنزلنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شك», and the preposition «من قبلك» is attached to «يقرءون». The clause «لقد جاءك الحق» is the answer to an oath. The clause «فلا تكونن» is conjoined to the clause «جاءك», and the linking element is implied, i.e. "by it". The preposition «من الممترين» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The fāʾ in «فتكون» is causative (sababiyya), and the abrogating verb is accusative by a concealed «أن» after the fāʾ. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no denial from you, and so loss".

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «ولو جاءتهم كل آية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «لا يؤمنون» in the preceding verse. This wāw conjoins to an implied ḥāl, i.e. "they do not believe in any state, even in this state". The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ), and «كانت» is a complete (tāmm) past verb. The clause «لما آمنوا كشفنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قوم يونس», and «لما» is a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence" (wujūb li-wujūb).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». The clause «أفأنت تكره» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تؤمن» is the noun of kāna, and the preposition «بإذن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تؤمن». The clause «ويجعل» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "so He permits some to believe".

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the "looking", suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which includes the meaning of knowing. «ما» in «وما تغني» is negating, and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «فانتظروا»: the fāʾ connects the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are waiting, then wait". «معكم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المنتظرين», and the preposition «من المنتظرين» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We save Our messengers with a saving like that". «حقًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted governing word, its implied form being "it is incumbent" (حَقَّ). The clause «ثم ننجي» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "We destroy the disobedient nations, then We save". The yāʾ was dropped from «نُنْج» in the script, following its dropping in pronunciation because of the meeting of two vowelless letters.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: «الناس» is a badal (substitute) from «أيها». «فلا أعبد»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and there is an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then I do not worship", so the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «لا أعبد» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). The preposition «من ديني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شك», and the preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «ولكن أعبد» is conjoined to the clause «لا أعبد». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أكون» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of an implied verb, i.e. "and it was revealed to me: set…". «أن» is not explicative, because the thing explained is not omitted. The clause «أقم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. The clause "and it was revealed to me: set…" is conjoined to the clause «أمرت».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «ما» is a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «إذًا» is a particle of answer with no governing effect.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the lā of generic negation. «إلا» is for restriction, and «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause «يصيب» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «وهو الغفور الرحيم».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «الناس» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) from «أيها». The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق». The clause «فمن اهتدى» is conjoined to the clause «قد جاءكم». «وما أنا»: «ما» operates like laysa, the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause is conjoined to the clause «قد جاءكم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The clause «وهو خير الحاكمين» is resumptive.
